operators.meaning: Freeze current candidate constants and action schema
Extract authoritative transition and fixed ticks
Compare matched runs with independent judge
Bind identities to territories and checkpoints
Model food and regenerative resource balance
Validate provenance and correction of data

constraints.rule: Source presence is not gameplay verification; partial old capabilities are not admitted as complete.
Finite stocks conserve units across trees, carriers, inventories, work in process and outputs.
All participants observe the same ordered state; client input cannot mint resources or self-award recognition.
Minimal pixel visual; region resources reflect frozen region profiles.
Player-earned materials must fund construction beyond a documented finite bootstrap.
Historical recognition is permanent and grounded in contribution evidence; title criteria, era admission and community rights require explicit contracts.

selection.objective: Inclusion-minimal prerequisite closure; counts only, no empirical effort ranking
selection.materialization_scope: Projection artifacts only; no gameplay implementation selected

audit.claim: Finite trees and timed harvest/production exist
Construction currently costs money, not delivered planks
Road route is recomputed each update and lacks persisted waypoint progress; possible oscillation requires experiment
Wood sent to base has no base-to-sawmill transfer in inspected code
Simulation orchestration uses requestAnimationFrame and caps dt; mission metrics use Date.now
Event log keeps only 12 messages and is not a complete replay trace

gaps.reason: Data customer/use case and external utility test absent; fictional game events are not real regional observations.
Existing Trajecta novelty definition and judge remain unvalidated.
Player engagement and recognition incentives unmeasured.
Effort, runtime costs and provider alternatives not calibrated.
Identity + utility + recognition increases retention; test with players. The design's 40% delivery gain is illustrative, not measured.
Freeze recipes, region yields, trade rules, monument/title criteria and era boundaries.
